reason: CON.40 (P2-021 Decision 4, C#-only first-party SDKs) stops new publication of the Maven identities io.github.arcforges:contracts-proto, contracts-connect-client and contract-fixtures after their Kotlin consumers migrated (AND.40). Their Kotlin and Java producer sources, the Gradle build and the Maven channel are removed, so no Dokka maven-javadoc archive is built any more and the three artifact targets of dokka-documentation-resources-r21 leave the active inventory. The C# NuGet packages are the replacement SDK surface. Already published Maven versions stay immutable and resolvable; nothing is unpublished, deprecated or deleted, and every historical record, artifact profile and receipt remains unchanged.
